title: Vet Website Design & Development | For Vets

facts.fact: The vendor states that adding a new page for a new vet, suburb, or service to a site it built carries no design fee.
facts.quote: There is no design fee for it

facts.fact: The vendor says it reads every review of the client clinic and of nearby clinics, not only the handful Google displays.
facts.quote: We pull every review of your clinic and of the clinics near you, not the handful Google shows

facts.fact: The vendor describes Gentle Vet Care as a mobile vet based in Melbourne's west, used as a case study.
facts.quote: a mobile vet in Melbourne's west

facts.fact: The vendor describes Caring Paws as a new clinic in Melbourne's east, used as a case study.
facts.quote: a new clinic in Melbourne's east

facts.fact: The vendor claims that reviews shown through a third-party widget are not read by Google as part of the clinic's site and therefore do nothing for rankings, which is why it builds reviews into the page as text.
facts.quote: Google does not read them as part of your site, so they do nothing for your rankings
